notes: 4.77.0 added an index enrichment stage (sp500_member, nasdaq100_member, dow_member) because the audit — reading the run_screen catalog — concluded no index-membership capability existed. It did: in_index, a universe-stage membership predicate that intersects constituent sets before anything is paid for, shipped earlier and was ALSO missing from the catalog. The same documentation defect that motivated 4.77.0 claimed 4.77.0 itself as a victim, and the lesson lands twice: a capability the catalog omits is absent to every agent consumer, and the fix is the catalog — never a second implementation.
